Synopsis
Dhurandhar, starring Ranveer Singh, is a box office sensation. The film continues its strong performance well into its fourth week. It has achieved impressive domestic earnings and crossed Rs 1,051 crore globally. Theatre occupancy remains high, reflecting sustained audience interest. Dhurandhar is now the highest-grossing release of 2025 so far.

Ranveer Singhs espionage thriller Dhurandhar continues to dominate the box office well into its fourth week, defying the usual slowdown seen after the initial rush. According to data shared by box-office tracking platform
Sacnilk,
the film added an impressive Rs 20.9 crore to its domestic earnings on its fourth Saturday alone. This surge pushed the India net total to Rs 706.40 crore. The upward trend continued on Sunday as well, with the film collecting an additional Rs 22.25 crore, reinforcing its remarkable theatrical run.

Strong Worldwide Numbers Cement Global Success
Beyond domestic markets, Dhurandhar has also delivered extraordinary results overseas. Within just 23 days of release, the film crossed the Rs 1,026 crore mark globally. Trade estimates indicate that the worldwide total has now moved beyond Rs 1,051 crore, as reported by Bollywood Hungama. These numbers place the Ranveer Singh-led project firmly among the
highest-grossing Indian films
of all time, especially within the action and spy genre.
Theatre Occupancy Reflects Sustained Audience Interest
Audience turnout remains healthy across cinema halls. On Saturday, the film recorded an overall Hindi occupancy of 38.48 per cent. Morning shows opened at a modest 20.54 per cent, but footfalls rose significantly as the day progressed. Evening shows registered 45.34 per cent occupancy, while night screenings followed closely at 42.27 per cent, indicating strong word-of-mouth and repeat viewership.
Breaking Records and Chasing Bigger Milestones
In terms of India net collections, Dhurandhar has already surpassed Prabhas Kalki 2898 AD, which concluded its run at Rs 646.31 crore domestically. The film is now steadily closing in on Shah Rukh Khans Pathaan, which amassed approximately Rs 1,055 crore worldwide.  As per a Bollywood Hungama report, the movie has amassed a collection of Rs 1051 crore already at the box-office. It is also locked in competition with Pushpa 2, whose Hindi version collected Rs 812.14 crore. Industry trackers confirm that Dhurandhar has emerged as the highest-grossing release of 2025 so far, outperforming titles like Kantara: Chapter 1 and Chhaava.

Released in 2025, Dhurandharwhich translates to Stalwartis a Hindi-language spy action thriller helmed by Aditya Dhar, who also served as writer and co-producer. Backed by
Jyoti
Deshpandes Jio Studios along with B62 Studios, the film features an ensemble cast including Ranveer Singh, Akshaye Khanna, Sanjay Dutt, R. Madhavan, Arjun Rampal, Sara Arjun and Rakesh Bedi, supported by several familiar faces.
As the first chapter in a planned two-part series, the narrative follows a covert anti-terror mission involving an undercover operative navigating Karachis criminal and political networks. The storyline draws inspiration from multiple real-world geopolitical incidents, blending fiction with historical undertones to heighten its impact.

Dhurandhar Box Office Collection Day 31: Ranveer Singh-led blockbuster eyes Pushpa 2s worldwide box office record
The action thriller Dhurandhar has garnered positive reviews and impressive box office earnings, reaching

1,186.25 crore globally. Directed by Aditya Dhar, it features Ranveer Singh and Akshaye Khanna. A sequel is confirmed for March 2026, promising a broader multi-language release.
Trisha Bhattacharya
Updated
4 Jan 2026, 07:24 PM IST
Ranveer Singh in a still from Dhurandhar.
Dhurandhar, the Ranveer Singh-led action espionage thriller, sustained a robust presence at theatres on its 31st day, adding significant revenue to an already formidable box office tally.
The film, directed by Aditya Dhar and featuring an ensemble cast that includes
Akshaye Khanna
, R. Madhavan, Arjun Rampal and Sanjay Dutt, has become one of the biggest commercial successes of the year, drawing sustained audience interest across India and abroad.
Dhurandhar's Domestic Performance  Day 31 and Week 5
On its 31st day (the fifth Sunday), Dhurandhar earned an estimated

10.07 crore at the Indian box office. This followed a

8.75 crore gross on Friday (Day 29) and a

11.75 crore weekend spike on Saturday (Day 30).

The fourth weeks total stood at

106.5 crore, reflecting steady audience turnout even five weeks after release. Taken together with earlier weeks, the films 30-day India net collection reached approximately

759.50 crore, with gross collections in India at

911.25 crore. The cumulative total across all markets early estimates place worldwide gross around

1,186.25 crore. These figures underscore the films rare longevity in theatres, defying the usual sharp drop-off after four weeks.
Dhurandhar's Overseas Collection
Overseas,
Dhurandhar
has delivered a strong performance for a Hindi-only release. Early trade reports indicate the films international collection at around

275.00 crore in its first 30 days, contributing to the global tally.
The movies success in overseas markets  particularly North America, where it has set new records for a Hindi film  has been a key driver of its worldwide total. This is notable given that the film was not released in several Gulf Cooperation Council countries, which typically comprise a significant share of
Bollywood
s overseas revenues.
Upcoming Sequel
The upcoming sequel of the film - Dhurandhar Part 2: The Revenge - is scheduled for a release on 19 March, 2026.

Box-office snapshot
Early estimates place Day 16 net at Rs 33.50 crore on Saturday, drawn from 5,398 shows across multiple regions. The film had kicked off Week 3 with Rs 22.50 crore on Friday at the ticket windows. The first week net stood at Rs 207.25 crore, while the second week added about Rs 253.25 crore. Milestones and records
Dhurandhar has emerged as the second-fastest Hindi film to surpass Rs 500 crore net, trailing only pushpa 2  The Rule at 11 days.It surpassed the earlier fastest milestones set by Shah rukh Khans Jawan (18 days) and this years Chhaava (23 days).
Stellar performance for ranveer Singh
The movie also marks Ranveer Singhs highest-grossing release to date, breaking into the Rs 500 crore club and overtaking his previous blockbusters by a wide margin.
Global box-office footprint
On Day 16,domestic box office tallies crossed the Rs 700 crore mark,with total India gross around Rs 780 crore. Overseas collections are estimated at about Rs 160 crore, bringing the worldwide total to roughly Rs 940 crore.
